users.overview: The users table stores information about registered users, including their unique identifier, name, and email address. This table serves as a central repository for user data and is referenced by other tables in the database. It plays a crucial role in managing user accounts and authentication.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: name
fields.description: The user's full name

fields.name: email
fields.description: The user's email address

orders.overview: The orders table stores information about individual orders, including the user who made the order and the product that was ordered. It serves as a bridge between the users and products tables, facilitating the management of order data. This table is crucial for tracking and analyzing sales and customer behavior.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the order

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: Identifier of the user who made the order, referencing the users table

fields.name: product_id
fields.description: Identifier of the product that was ordered, referencing the products table

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Quantity of the product ordered

products.overview: The products table stores information about the various products available. It contains details such as the product's id, name, and price. This table serves as a central repository for product data.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the product

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the product

fields.name: price
fields.description: Price of the product

airports.overview: The airports table stores information about various airports, including their name, city, and country. This table serves as a reference point for other tables, such as routes, to establish relationships between airports. It provides a centralized location for airport data.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the airport

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the airport

fields.name: city
fields.description: City where the airport is located

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country where the airport is located

routes.overview: The routes table stores information about different flight routes, including the source and destination airports. Each route is uniquely identified by an id. The table establishes relationships with the airports and flights tables to provide a comprehensive view of flight operations.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the route

fields.name: source_airport
fields.description: The id of the source airport

fields.name: destination_airport
fields.description: The id of the destination airport

airlines.overview: The airlines table stores information about different airlines, including their unique identifier, name, and country of origin. This table serves as a reference point for other tables that require airline data. It provides a centralized location for managing airline information.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the airline

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the airline

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country of origin for the airline

flights.overview: The flights table stores information about individual flights, including their departure and arrival times, as well as the airline and route they belong to. This table serves as a central hub for flight-related data and is connected to other tables through foreign key relationships. It provides a foundation for managing and analyzing flight operations.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the flight

fields.name: airline_id
fields.description: Identifier for the airline operating the flight

fields.name: route_id
fields.description: Identifier for the route the flight is taking

fields.name: departure_time
fields.description: Scheduled departure time for the flight

fields.name: arrival_time
fields.description: Scheduled arrival time for the flight

passengers.overview: The passengers table stores information about individual passengers, including their personal details and identification. This table serves as a central repository for passenger data, which can be referenced by other tables. It provides a foundation for managing passenger-related information.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the passenger

fields.name: name
fields.description: Passenger's full name

fields.name: email
fields.description: Passenger's email address

fields.name: passport_number
fields.description: Passenger's passport number

bookings.overview: The bookings table stores information about flight bookings, including the passenger and flight details. It serves as a bridge between passengers and flights, facilitating the management of bookings. This table is crucial for tracking and managing flight reservations.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the booking

fields.name: passenger_id
fields.description: Reference to the passenger who made the booking

fields.name: flight_id
fields.description: Reference to the flight that was booked

fields.name: booking_date
fields.description: Date the booking was made

tickets.overview: The tickets table stores information about individual tickets, including their booking details and seat assignments. It serves as a central location for managing ticket data. This table is crucial for tracking ticket sales and customer bookings.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the ticket

fields.name: booking_id
fields.description: Reference to the booking that this ticket belongs to

fields.name: seat_number
fields.description: The seat number assigned to the ticket

fields.name: class
fields.description: The class of service for the ticket (e.g. economy, premium, etc.)

crew.overview: The crew table stores information about individual crew members, including their name, role, and the airline they are associated with. This table serves as a central repository for crew data and facilitates relationships with other tables, such as airlines and flight_crew. It enables efficient management and querying of crew-related data.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the crew member

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the crew member

fields.name: role
fields.description: Role or position of the crew member

fields.name: airline_id
fields.description: Identifier of the airline the crew member is associated with

flight_crew.overview: The flight_crew table serves as a bridge between flights and crew members, establishing many-to-many relationships between the two entities. It allows for efficient management of crew assignments to flights. This table is crucial for maintaining accurate records of flight personnel.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the flight-crew relationship

fields.name: flight_id
fields.description: Foreign key referencing the flights table

fields.name: crew_id
fields.description: Foreign key referencing the crew table

product_category_name_translation.overview: The product_category_name_translation table stores translations of product category names. It contains two fields to store the original and English translations of product category names. This table enables multilingual support for product categories.

fields.name: product_category_name
fields.description: The original product category name

fields.name: product_category_name_english
fields.description: The English translation of the product category name

orders_bridge.overview: The orders_bridge table serves as a central hub for order-related data, providing a common reference point for various order datasets. It contains a single field, order_id, which is used to establish relationships with other tables. This table enables efficient querying and joining of order data across different datasets.

fields.name: order_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for an order

olist_order_items_dataset.overview: The olist_order_items_dataset table stores information about individual items within orders, including product and seller details. It serves as a bridge between orders and products, facilitating the analysis of sales and shipping data. This table is crucial for understanding customer purchasing behavior and supply chain operations.

fields.name: order_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the order

fields.name: order_item_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the order item

fields.name: product_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the product

fields.name: seller_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the seller

fields.name: shipping_limit_date
fields.description: The latest date by which the order item should be shipped

fields.name: price
fields.description: The price of the order item

fields.name: freight_value
fields.description: The shipping cost of the order item

relationships: The olist_order_items_dataset table references the orders_bridge table via the order_id column
The olist_order_items_dataset table references the olist_sellers_dataset table via the seller_id column

geolocation_unique.overview: The geolocation_unique table stores unique geolocation data, including zip code prefix, latitude, longitude, city, and state. This table serves as a reference point for other tables that contain geolocation information. It helps to reduce data redundancy and improve data consistency.

fields.name: geolocation_zip_code_prefix
fields.description: Unique zip code prefix for a geolocation

fields.name: geolocation_lat
fields.description: Latitude of the geolocation

fields.name: geolocation_lng
fields.description: Longitude of the geolocation

fields.name: geolocation_city
fields.description: City of the geolocation

fields.name: geolocation_state
fields.description: State of the geolocation

olist_order_payments_dataset.overview: The olist_order_payments_dataset table stores information about payments made for orders, including the payment method, number of installments, and payment value. This table is used to track and analyze payment data for orders. It provides valuable insights into customer payment behavior.

fields.name: order_id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the order

fields.name: payment_sequential
fields.description: The sequential number of the payment

fields.name: payment_type
fields.description: The type of payment made (e.g. credit card, bank transfer)

fields.name: payment_installments
fields.description: The number of installments for the payment

fields.name: payment_value
fields.description: The total value of the payment

relationships: The olist_order_payments_dataset table has a foreign key relationship with the orders_bridge table via the order_id column.

olist_customers_dataset.overview: The olist_customers_dataset table stores information about customers, including their unique identifiers, location details, and state. This table serves as a central repository for customer data, facilitating analysis and insights. It is connected to other tables through foreign key relationships, enabling a comprehensive understanding of customer interactions.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the customer

fields.name: customer_unique_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the customer

fields.name: customer_zip_code_prefix
fields.description: Zip code prefix of the customer's location

fields.name: customer_city
fields.description: City of the customer's location

fields.name: customer_state
fields.description: State of the customer's location

olist_order_reviews_dataset.overview: The olist_order_reviews_dataset table stores information about customer reviews for orders. It contains details such as review scores, comments, and timestamps. This table is used to track customer feedback and satisfaction with their orders.

fields.name: review_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the review

fields.name: order_id
fields.description: Identifier for the order being reviewed

fields.name: review_score
fields.description: The customer's review score

fields.name: review_comment_title
fields.description: The title of the customer's review comment

fields.name: review_comment_message
fields.description: The content of the customer's review comment

fields.name: review_creation_date
fields.description: The date the review was created

fields.name: review_answer_timestamp
fields.description: The timestamp when the review was answered

relationships: The olist_order_reviews_dataset table has a foreign key relationship with the orders_bridge table through the order_id field.

olist_geolocation_dataset.overview: The olist_geolocation_dataset table stores geographic location data, including zip code prefixes, latitude, longitude, city, and state. This table provides a reference for geolocation information. It can be used to map locations and analyze geographic trends.

fields.name: geolocation_zip_code_prefix
fields.description: The zip code prefix of the geolocation

fields.name: geolocation_lat
fields.description: The latitude of the geolocation

fields.name: geolocation_lng
fields.description: The longitude of the geolocation

fields.name: geolocation_city
fields.description: The city of the geolocation

fields.name: geolocation_state
fields.description: The state of the geolocation

olist_sellers_dataset.overview: The olist_sellers_dataset table stores information about sellers, including their unique identifier, zip code prefix, city, and state. This table serves as a reference for seller data and is used to establish relationships with other tables. It provides essential details about sellers in the dataset.

fields.name: seller_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the seller

fields.name: seller_zip_code_prefix
fields.description: Zip code prefix of the seller's location

fields.name: seller_city
fields.description: City where the seller is located

fields.name: seller_state
fields.description: State where the seller is located
